findings.title: Two Palestinians wounded by Israeli gunfire in Beit Lahia, northern Gaza
findings.source_title: مصابان برصاص الاحتلال في بلدة بيت لاهيا
findings.location: Beit Lahia, North Gaza governorate, Gaza Strip, occupied Palestinian territory
findings.affected_population_system: Two Palestinian civilians reported wounded by gunfire and transported to a medical facility; condition described as varying severity
findings.finding_summary: WAFA reports, citing a medical source, that two people with gunshot injuries of differing severity arrived at a medical facility following Israeli military gunfire in Beit Lahia on 16 November. English WAFA version posted at 12:16 Jerusalem time; Al Jazeera's 16 November report independently mentions the episode but cites an ambulance/emergency source and agencies. This is distinct from the already ledgered Jabalia fatal shooting and Khan Younis school injuries. The original Arabic report predates the prior 04:01 PST cutoff and therefore is a late-recalled, newly identified incident, not an event newly occurring during this hour.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: وأفاد مصدر طبي، بوصول إصابتين بجروح متفاوتة برصاص قوات الاحتلال في بلدة بيت لاهيا شمال القطاع.
